reason: I never search for events, I just stumble on them in stories after dinner, so an app I have to remember to open is dead to me within a week. The yoga and book club stuff actually sounds like my thing, but it would have to find me, not the other way around.
objection: I do not go looking for plans. If it is not in my Instagram stories or reposted by a friend, it does not exist for me, and I am not buying a 700 Lek ticket to anything when I have basically no money.
would_change_my_mind: If the app had its own Instagram with story posts of the free events that my friends would repost, so I stumble on it the way I stumble on everything else, I would probably show up to a free yoga or book club thing and go from there.
